evidence.quote: the Committee decided to continue through the end of the year our program of lengthening the maturity of our securities holdings rather than completing the program this month as previously scheduled.
I think at this point, we still do have considerable scope to do more, and we are prepared to do more.
most participants see the risks to the outlook weighted mainly toward slower growth and higher unemployment.
the Committee anticipates that inflation over the medium run will run at or below the 2 percent rate
Employment gains have been smaller in recent months, and the unemployment rate, at 8.2 percent, remains elevated.
additional asset purchases would be among the things that we would certainly consider if we need to take additional measures to strengthen the economy.

parsed.rationale: The Chair announces an extension of Operation Twist, repeatedly signals readiness for further easing including asset purchases, and stresses downside risks from Europe and fiscal policy with inflation at or below 2 percent. Noted costs of nonstandard tools only modestly temper a clearly dovish message.
